[NTST.13.1] **The runtime runs an artefact's tests itself.** `ds_test_run(dsc, len, cfg, &report)` runs the test cases a compiled
artefact carries ([LTSL.2.4], [RLOW.17.1]) as [RTIM.14] states. For each
`TestCase` it creates an engine of its own, loads the artefact into it ([RTIM.14.3])
and drives the case on the mock clock ([RTIM.14.2]). It takes no engine of the
caller's and touches none. `cfg` selects every case, or the one whose `test_id`
it names; a `NULL` `cfg` selects every case. Both runtimes **must** provide it.

The call's status says whether the run happened, not whether the cases passed:

- `DS_OK`: every selected case ran, and `*report` holds the results ([NTST.13.2]),
  passing or failing.
- The load's own code ([RDSC.11.1]), when the artefact is refused before any case
  runs. `*report` is `NULL`.
- `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` or `DS_ERR_DSC_DANGLING`, when the artefact's test atoms
  cannot be read ([RTIM.14.15]). `*report` is `NULL`.
- `DS_ERR_NOT_FOUND`, when `cfg` names a `test_id` the artefact does not carry.
- `DS_ERR_INVAL` for a `NULL` `dsc` or `report`, and `DS_ERR_OOM`.
